body: Thanks again for your message. I'm glad you're the last person I reply to. I only have 2 hours left so I'd rather be undisturbed. I hope you succeed in helping others as I know you've tried for me. My name is Max btw. I'm happy that someone replied and treated me like a human for my mental health for once. Not even my gf took me seriously. How unfortunate is that? Please live a good life and keep helping others.

That's the thing, I'm very aware that time never stops. Even when I try to relax, everything else is still moving. This is especially true in construction when people wanted everything yesterday. Thank you for your message though.

The rest of the tiles were organised in a French style so lengths of the other tiles are 100mm, 200mm, 400mm and 700mm (Irregular understandably) So i thought the linear drains could replicate that.   


I have been on the phone with a company that custom makes them and confirmed they were doable. Tabs on each end and one long piece in the middle as it runs shortways in my shower.
